title: CC 6000 air purifier
description: CC 6000 air purifier with interchangeable filters — high airflow and reduced particles, odours and VOCs.
paragraphs: CC 6000 is an air purifier that can be equipped with different filters according to the need and application. The filters ensure that the CC 6000 air purifier effectively reduces harmful particles, odours and other volatile organic compounds commonly found in indoor air in homes, offices, schools, hospitals, sports halls and other public buildings.
benefits: Reduced presence of volatile organic compounds in the air
